_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor Performance Assessment Report
summary: The Contractor Performance Assessment Report provides the Government with the Contractor's assessment of their own performance.
use_relationship:
The Contractor Performance Assessment Report will provide the Government with the Contractor's assessment of their performance.
This data item description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractor Performance Assessment Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall contain the following Sections:

children.title: Training Requirements/Qualifications.
children.content: This section shall identify all mandatory training requirements/qualifications in support of the contracts requirements. It shall also contain status of mandatory training/certificates in percentage of total completion and show status on upcoming qualifications accompanied and how all documentation for the designated reporting period was verified.

children.title: Timeliness of filling personnel requisitions.
children.content: This section shall identify the average number of days required to fill each requisition during the reporting period in comparison to industry average. It shall also identify what efforts are being taken during the hiring process to fill challenging personnel requisitions.

children.title: CDRL Quality and Timeliness.
children.content: This section shall contain a list of all required CDRLs along with their respective delivery frequency, metrics as to the timeliness, and accuracy of submitted CDRLs for the given reporting period. This section shall also identify the overall accuracy rate objective, achieved CDRL accuracy results and overall rate of error(s) requiring CDRL revision.

children.title: Occupational Near-Mishap/Injury/Illness Reporting.
children.content: This section information concerning occupational safety incidents occurring in support of contract requirements and shall include each incident, date of incident and the percentage of incident reports submitted within eight (8) working hours of the incident, and the overall injury rate for the contract period in comparison to the industry standards.

children.title: Personnel Retention Rates.
children.content: This section shall contain personnel retention rates both overall and categorized and identified with reason for separation.

children.title: Media Requirements.
children.content: The Contractors Performance Assessment Report shall be in Microsoft Power Point, version 2007-2010.
